notes: 13 searches. Not retrieved by any search: urgent/emergency routes (999, NHS 111) for anaemia red flags, sickle cell pain/care, B12/folate-specific diagnostic wording, kidney disease/cancer/UC/RA examples for chronic disease anaemia, pregnancy as folate cause. Several attributions rest on blended search summaries (e.g. NHS 111 Wales, NHS inform); a reviewer may re-confirm on the pages. Claims c65-c69 are sentences added in the final text. Existing conditions.json treatment text says oral iron for three months after correction, while search results mention tablets typically for about six months (NHS) and three to six months (NHLBI); and its seekCare red flags were not confirmable from retrieved text.
